verdict.rationale: Auth0's docs describe built-in brute-force protection: proactively blocking suspicious IPs after consecutive failed login attempts. They also cover breached-password detection that can notify users or block login, a database of compromised credentials against large-scale account takeover (credential stuffing), and risk-based Adaptive MFA plus tenant ACL deny rules. Missing for 10: any explicit evidence of bot detection or CAPTCHA, in-depth configuration docs (thresholds, lockout behavior), and independent or hands-on corroboration that these protections work.
